name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of 'best practice' workflows — spec, plan, build, test, review, ship — that make AI coding agents work more like disciplined senior engineers.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small-to-mid startup who wants their AI-assisted dev team to follow consistent, high-quality workflows without hiring more senior engineers.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it across the team's AI coding agents to enforce spec-before-code and test-driven workflows without constant manual oversight.
A fractional CTO consultant deploys it as part of an 'AI engineering process setup' service for clients.
An agency builds a custom skill pack on top of it and resells it as a productized workflow to other dev shops.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid consulting package to set up and customize these workflows for a client's engineering team
Build and sell premium, industry-specific skill packs (e.g. fintech compliance, healthcare)

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AI engineering workflow setup' package for small dev teams wanting disciplined AI-assisted development without hiring a senior engineer.
